$comment: The response envelope every read resource shares. Licensing: envelope.schema.json.license (REUSE sidecar).
title: MAINLINE console — read response envelope
description: Every read the console performs returns this shape, over HTTP from the kernel's read API or byte-for-byte out of an evidence bundle frame. The two transports are interchangeable BECAUSE the envelope is the same object; if they differed here they would differ in a code path, and the LIVE/REPLAY badge would be decoration.

envelope_version.description: MUST be 1. A reader that does not recognise the version refuses the payload rather than guessing at it.

resource.description: The resource key from src/data/resources.ts. The transport asserts this equals the key it asked for — a frame that answers a different question than the one asked is a tampered bundle, not a convenience.

schema_id.description: The $id of the contract that governs `data`. The console looks the schema up by this value and refuses a payload naming a schema it does not hold — an unknown contract is not a forward-compatible contract.

observed_at.description: When the read API produced this payload. Null when the emitter declined to state it; never defaulted to now().

server_date.description: The server's own clock at emission, carried so the honesty chrome can show server-vs-local skew (D16) without the console having to trust a header a proxy may have rewritten.

staged.description: True when any part of `data` is hand-authored demonstration material rather than a value a cluster produced. The honesty chrome renders this; a bundle of staged frames says STAGED on every screen it feeds.

staged_note.description: Required and non-null exactly when `staged` is true. Says what was staged and why, in the words of whoever staged it.

statement_refs.description: Where the payload came from. Empty is legal and means the emitter named no source, which the console displays as an absence rather than hiding.

data.description: The resource payload. Constrained by the resource contract named in schema_id, never by this file.

allOf.$comment: staged true <-> staged_note non-null. The same shape spec/wire/refusal.schema.json uses for naa/naa_reason, for the same reason: an unexplained flag is a flag nobody has to justify.
